meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,你说要接 Google Chat,Claude 会从 channels 分支把适配器和测试文件拷入项目、注册渠道、安装固定版本依赖,再构建并跑注册测试;随后提示你粘贴服务账号 JSON 写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你想把 Google Chat 加为 NanoClaw 的消息渠道,或要求“加 Google Chat”“接入 Chat SDK”时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 渠道。
say.note: 会拷贝适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 接入 Google Chat 后,服务账号怎么配?
say.note: 会说明 Google Cloud Console 的步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接 Google Chat,并跑一下集成测试。
say.note: 会构建项目并执行注册测试。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Google Chat adapter and registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it in the barrel, installs the pinned dependency, builds, and runs the registration test. It then prompts for the service-account JSON and stores it in .env.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to add Google Chat as a NanoClaw channel or to integrate it via the Chat SDK.

say_en.note: Copies, registers, and installs the gchat adapter.

say_en.text: How do I configure the service account after adding Google Chat?
Add Google Chat to NanoClaw and run the integration test.
say_en.note: Builds the project and runs the registration test.
